column1: What did James Prescott Joule's 1843 paddle-wheel calorimetry experiment demonstrate?
column2: Joule's experiment demonstrated that a precise quantity of mechanical work produced a reproducible temperature rise in water, establishing the mechanical equivalent of heat at approximately 4.184 joules per calorie.
